name: The Great Sith War begins
summary: Kun and Qel-Droma opened their war on the Republic on several fronts at once: Kun to corrupt the Jedi from within, Ulic to build an army from the Krath, the Mandalorians and stolen Republic warships. The Jedi Order would be gutted before it ended.

name: Exar Kun recruits Jedi to the Brotherhood
summary: Kun returned to Ossus as a self-styled Jedi reformer and seduced a generation of students, Crado and Oss Wilum among them, with a Sith holocron and promises of power. He then murdered Odan-Urr in the Great Library to take the holocron for himself.

name: The Krath seize the Foerost Shipyards
summary: Ulic's forces stormed the Foerost shipyards and carried off three hundred new Republic warships, giving the Brotherhood a modern navy in a single stroke. The ships would spearhead the assault on Coruscant.

name: Kun's converts murder their Jedi masters

location.note: carried out across many Jedi worlds

summary: At Kun's command his new Sith acolytes scattered across the galaxy and killed the Jedi Masters who had trained them. The Order lost dozens of its most experienced teachers in a single night of betrayal.

name: Ulic Qel-Droma defeats Mandalore the Indomitable on Kuar
summary: Mandalore the Indomitable challenged the new Sith warlord to single combat among the ruins of Kuar to prove the Mandalorians the greater warriors. Ulic beat him, and by Mandalorian custom the Crusaders became his to command.

name: The Mandalorian Crusaders join the Sith war
summary: Bound by their defeated leader's oath, the Mandalorian Crusaders and their Basilisk war droids became the shock troops of the Brotherhood. Their raids in the Sith War were the first time the Mandalorians fought the Republic as a whole.

name: Ulic Qel-Droma assaults Coruscant
summary: Krath warships and Mandalorian Basilisk droids hit Coruscant in the largest assault on the capital since the Hyperspace War. Aleema Keto withdrew the fleet at the critical moment, leaving Ulic to be captured by Nomi Sunrider and the Jedi.

name: Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma; Exar Kun kills Vodo-Siosk Baas
summary: Put on trial before the Senate, Ulic was rescued when Kun and Mandalore the Indomitable stormed the chamber. Kun killed his old master Vodo-Siosk Baas in a duel on the Senate floor, paralysed the assembly, and left with his apprentice.

name: Mandalorian assault on Onderon
summary: On Ulic's orders Mandalore the Indomitable led the Crusaders against Onderon and the Jedi protecting it. The attack failed against Republic reinforcements, and the retreating Mandalorians were driven onto Dxun.

name: Mandalore the Indomitable dies on Dxun; Mandalore the Ultimate takes the mask
summary: Shot down over Dxun, Mandalore the Indomitable was eaten by the moon's predators. The warrior who found his mask took the name Mandalore the Ultimate and spent the next generation rebuilding the clans into the Neo-Crusaders.

name: The Cron Cluster supernova devastates Ossus
summary: To clear the way for a raid on the Jedi library, Kun had Aleema Keto use Naga Sadow's ancient warship to rip the cores from the Cron Cluster's stars. The resulting supernova killed Aleema and the Republic fleet shadowing her, and its shockwave scoured Ossus.

name: Evacuation of Ossus
summary: With the shockwave hours away, the Jedi loaded what they could of twenty millennia of records onto every available ship while Kun's forces raided the planet for Sith artefacts. Master Ood Bnar rooted himself over a cache of lightsabers to guard it.

name: Ulic kills his brother; Nomi Sunrider severs him from the Force
summary: During the evacuation Ulic struck down his brother Cay in a duel and, in the shock of it, surrendered to Nomi Sunrider. She used an ancient technique to wall him off from the Force forever, and the broken Sith lord agreed to lead the Jedi to Kun.

name: The Jedi assault Yavin 4
summary: Guided by Ulic, a Jedi armada and Republic fleet descended on Kun's stronghold. Kun drained the lives of his Massassi to bind his spirit into the temples before a wall of light raised by the Jedi burned the moon's jungles and trapped him there.

name: End of the Great Sith War
summary: With Kun entombed and the Krath leaderless, the Brotherhood of the Sith dissolved and the Koros system returned to the Republic. The war had killed thousands of Jedi, destroyed Ossus and left the Order with a deep distrust of ambition that lasted into the Mandalorian Wars.

name: The Jedi Order's centre shifts from Ossus to Coruscant
summary: With Ossus unlivable, the Jedi made the Temple on Coruscant, built on the site of an ancient Sith shrine, the seat of the High Council. The Order would be headquartered there until the fall of the Republic.

name: Formation of the Jedi Covenant
summary: Shaken by how easily Kun had turned their students, Jedi Master Krynda Draay founded a secret society of seers sworn to detect and stop the next Sith before they rose. Its paranoia would lead to murder on Taris.

name: The Great Hunt for the terentateks
summary: Jedi hunters tracked the Sith-spawned terentateks that Exar Kun had loosed to prey on Force-sensitives, cornering them on Korriban, Kashyyyk and Tatooine. The Hunt cost many Jedi their lives but was declared complete around 3,990 BBY.

name: Death of Ulic Qel-Droma on Rhen Var
summary: Ten years after the war, the blind and Force-dead Ulic was living in exile on the ice world Rhen Var, training Nomi Sunrider's daughter Vima. A spacer seeking fame shot him in the back; his body vanished into the Force as he died.

name: The Kanz Disorders
summary: A Republic administrator in the Kanz sector declared himself sovereign and enslaved the Lorrdian people for three centuries while the Republic, drained by the Sith and Mandalorian wars, looked away. Jedi intervention finally ended the tyranny in 3,670 BBY.
